{{Quote|Well I run the place. You can't expect me to go off and help out a wayward employee, can you?|Cuan Talon, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TS" />}}
'''Cuan Talon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] alive during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He ran [[Tosche Station/Legends|Tosche Station]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], along with his warehouse manager [[Janus]].<ref name="SWG:TS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> spacers approached Cuan with an inquiry about a droid recently acquired by Janus from the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] traders of [[Sand Crawler 345]]. The spacers were hired by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arlan Barrezz|Barrezz]] as well as [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carh'la Bastra|Bastra]] who both were looking for the droid. Cuan replied that he had no idea about the droid's location, though Janus might have. He informed them that Janus had crashed his [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] earlier that day, and he gave the spacer the location of his employee. After arriving at the location, the spacers would report to Cuan that Janus had been killed by [[Desert Demons]].<ref name="SWG:TS" /> Cuan Talon was also friend with an old woman named [[Sorna]] and tried to help her as often as possible.<ref name="SWG:FS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Sorna|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Cuan Talon was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Cuan Talon was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
